claude.performance_metric: TSR $19.37 per $100 at 5yr (to YE2021); FY2020 net loss $242.2M and $246.0M license impairment
claude.rationale: The slice documents financial deterioration in FY2020 (revenue fall to $1,060,898K, $242,224K net loss, $246.0M license impairment) with FY2021 recovery, but attributes the disruption to the COVID-19 pandemic and generic merger integration/restructuring costs rather than to any product-vs-operations misalignment, so p4 is coded 0. On the process/organization interface, the merger-related and pandemic-related workforce reductions ($12.0M in 2020, $5.7M in 2021), furloughs, and restructuring are itemized jointly with COVID measures without isolating an operations-vs-people/culture fracture attributable to the deal, so p5 is coded uncertain. No evidence bears on the controlling-intent archetype (t1 uncertain), and no reconcilability-of-business-models incompatibility is documented (t2 = 0).
